units.source_text: 初死期间，儿子等因父亲遗命言犹在耳，事继母毕恭毕敬。

en.t: For a while after his death, the sons, with their father's last wishes still ringing in their ears, served their stepmother with the utmost respect.

units.source_text: 但也只是表面之事，实际上使空蝉伤心之处甚多。

en.t: But this was only a matter of appearances; in truth, there was much that caused Utsusemi pain.

units.source_text: 她明知人情冷暖，乃世间必然之事。

en.t: She knew well that warmth and coldness in human feeling were simply the way of the world.

units.source_text: 因此并不怨天尤人，只管悲叹自身命苦。

en.t: For that reason she blamed neither heaven nor other people, and only lamented her own bitter fate.

units.source_text: 诸子之中，惟有那河内守，只因自昔恋慕于她，待她较别人稍亲切些。

en.t: Among the sons, only the Governor of Kawachi treated her a little more kindly than the others, because he had long been in love with her.

units.source_text: “父亲谆切叮嘱，我岂敢违背遗命？

en.t: "Father earnestly instructed me; how could I dare go against his dying command?

units.source_text: 我虽微不足数，尚请随时使唤，勿存疏远之心。”

en.t: Though I am of little account, please call on me whenever you wish, and do not think of me as distant from you."

units.source_text: 形似亲近孝顺，实则存心不良。

en.t: Outwardly he seemed close and dutiful, but in truth his intentions were improper.

units.source_text: “我因前世作孽，今世做了寡妇。

en.t: "Because I sinned in a former life, I have become a widow in this one.

units.source_text: 长此下去，结果那儿子恐将对我说出世间罕有的讨厌话来。”

en.t: If things go on like this, that son will surely end by saying something hateful to me, the like of which is rarely heard in the world."

units.source_text: 她悄悄地自伤薄命，便不告诉人，削发做了尼姑。

en.t: Quietly grieving over her unlucky fate, she told no one, cut off her hair, and became a nun.

units.source_text: 她的随身侍女，都悲叹这不可挽回之事。

en.t: All the ladies who attended her mourned this irreversible act.
When the Governor of Kawachi heard the news, he said resentfully:
"She detested me, and that is why she took religious vows.

units.source_text: 来日方长，看她如何过得。

en.t: There are many days ahead; we shall see how she manages to live.

units.source_text: 此种贤良，毋乃太乏味了！”

en.t: Such virtue is surely far too dull!"
